title: CPL 2026 Live Streaming Guide: Channels by Country
description: Find the official CPL 2026 TV channel or streaming platform for 16 territories, including the Caribbean, India, Pakistan, UK, USA and Australia.
headline: CPL 2026 live streaming guide
lede: CPL has confirmed its worldwide television and digital partners for 2026. Use this country guide to find the broadcaster announced for your territory, then check the exact match in that service's schedule.

territory_notes.Australia: Fox and YouTube are the announced Australian viewing routes.
territory_notes.Guyana: E-Networks is the local broadcaster named for Guyana.
territory_notes.Europe: Cricbuzz is listed for European coverage.
territory_notes.India — linear TV: JioStar holds India's announced linear television coverage.
territory_notes.Indian subcontinent — digital: YouTube and FanCode are the announced digital routes across the Indian subcontinent.
territory_notes.Middle East and North Africa: Cricbuzz is listed for the Middle East and North Africa.
territory_notes.New Zealand: Sky NZ and YouTube are the announced New Zealand routes.
territory_notes.North America: Willow is the announced broadcaster for the United States and Canada.
territory_notes.Pakistan: TapMad and YouTube are the announced options in Pakistan.
territory_notes.Bangladesh: TapMad and YouTube are the announced options in Bangladesh.
territory_notes.Pan-Caribbean: Rush Live & Louder provides pan-Caribbean coverage through participating providers.
territory_notes.Rest of the world: YouTube serves territories included by CPL in the rest-of-world category.
territory_notes.Saint Lucia: Winners TV is the additional local broadcaster named for Saint Lucia.
territory_notes.South East Asia: Cricbuzz is listed for South East Asian coverage.
territory_notes.Trinidad & Tobago: CNC3 is the additional local broadcaster named for Trinidad and Tobago.
territory_notes.United Kingdom: TNT is the announced United Kingdom broadcaster.

platform_guides.label: YouTube coverage
platform_guides.title: Available in named territories
platform_guides.text: CPL lists YouTube for Australia, New Zealand, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Indian-subcontinent digital coverage and the rest of the world. A stream can still be restricted by location.

platform_guides.label: North America
platform_guides.title: Willow
platform_guides.text: Willow serves the United States and Canada through its television, website, app and participating-provider routes, subject to the selected plan.

platform_guides.label: India and subcontinent
platform_guides.title: JioStar, FanCode and YouTube
platform_guides.text: JioStar is listed for linear television in India. FanCode and YouTube are the digital partners announced across the Indian subcontinent.

platform_guides.label: Pakistan and Bangladesh
platform_guides.title: TapMad and YouTube
platform_guides.text: Both services are named for Pakistan and Bangladesh. Check the individual event listing and geographic availability before subscribing.

platform_guides.label: Europe, MENA and South East Asia
platform_guides.title: Cricbuzz
platform_guides.text: Cricbuzz is the broadcaster named across Europe, the Middle East and North Africa, and South East Asia.

faq.question: Where can I watch CPL 2026 live in the USA and Canada?
faq.answer: Willow is the official North American broadcaster announced for CPL 2026. Viewers should check Willow's current television, web or app schedule for the individual match and subscription requirements.

faq.question: Which channel shows CPL 2026 in the Caribbean?
faq.answer: Rush Live & Louder provides pan-Caribbean coverage. CPL also names E-Networks in Guyana, Winners TV in Saint Lucia and CNC3 in Trinidad and Tobago. Provider, package and channel availability can vary.

faq.question: Where can I watch CPL 2026 in India?
faq.answer: CPL lists JioStar for linear television in India. YouTube and FanCode provide the announced digital coverage across the Indian subcontinent.

faq.question: Where can I watch CPL 2026 in Pakistan and Bangladesh?
faq.answer: TapMad and YouTube are the official services announced for both Pakistan and Bangladesh. Geographic restrictions and account requirements may apply.

faq.question: Is CPL 2026 available on YouTube?
faq.answer: Yes. CPL lists YouTube for Australia, New Zealand, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Indian-subcontinent digital coverage and the rest of the world. Availability depends on the territory attached to the stream.

faq.question: Who shows CPL 2026 in the United Kingdom?
faq.answer: TNT is the broadcaster named by CPL for the United Kingdom. Check TNT's current programming guide for the exact fixture and channel.

faq.question: What time do CPL matches start in my country?
faq.answer: The official schedule uses the host venue's local time. Most Caribbean host territories use UTC-4, while Jamaica uses UTC-5. The tournament includes several start times, so always check the individual fixture.
